name: Tob
line: Tob was a land east of the Jordan where Jephthah took refuge after his brothers drove him out, and where Gilead's elders later came to call him back.

moments.title: Jephthah flees to Tob
moments.text: Jephthah's brothers drove him out of his father's house. He fled and settled in the land of Tob, where worthless men gathered around him and traveled with him.

moments.title: The elders call Jephthah back
moments.text: When the Ammonites made war on Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from Tob. They asked him to be their commander, and he agreed to go with them.
